_what: Barkaritaville Dog Park -- the open grounds around the pin, and the drive in.
_why_this_file_exists: Karen asked for the area around the dog park to be shown green with its road,
rather than as more of the Town Center's dark amenity slate. She is right that
it reads wrong otherwise: the dog park is open parkland, not built amenity, and
the map was colouring it the same as the Bandshell and the fitness centre.
_how_measured: Karen drew the area and the drive directly on our own poster, so the whole
chain inverts -- the same route the West Bay Center block came in by.
This time the frame was a CROP, so only two landmark pins were in it. Every
assignment of the two detected coral blobs to known pins was tried and solved
for scale and translation; the Dog Park / Stay & Play pairing closed with a
second-point residual of 0.0 poster px at k = 1.349.
A second pairing (Paradise Pool / kayak launch) also fitted the two points, at
k = 0.372. It is wrong on scale: that would make the crop 226 m across, and it
plainly shows Latitude Blvd, a whole phase of lots and several streets, which
is 800 m of ground. The chosen fit puts the crop at 825 x 593 m.
VERIFIED the way this project requires: our own phase outlines were drawn onto
her crop and land exactly on the colour boundaries she screenshotted -- the
Phase 3A edge and the Town Center tract edge both track to the pixel.
_accuracy: The RECOVERY of her line is good to a few metres. The LINE is a freehand
sketch of where the grounds are, not a surveyed boundary, and at 18.9 acres it
is the open parcel rather than a fenced run. Drawn with a soft edge and no
acreage printed, so it reads as the indication it is.
The drive is about 880 m2 of the same sketch and is drawn as a path, not a
name: Barkaritaville Dog Park
